entries.conditions: DRQ int8 channelwise weights + fp32 activations: an FC on a rank-3 [1,T,C] input whose OUTPUT feeds an ADD (residual or two-input) aborts delegate kernel creation — ml_drift delegate_opencl 'Unable to parse bc coord for BATCH axis. Layout is bhwc' — and the whole CompiledModel GPU compile fails (no CPU fallback). Isolated rank-3 DRQ FC compiles; rank-2 FC+ADD compiles; the identical graph in f32 compiles. Kills every DRQ transformer/conformer block with residual FCs. Minimal repro: 1.0 MB x+Linear(x) tflite (parakeet-ja-work/drq_probes/bisect_resadd1_i8.tflite).

evidence.source_model: parakeet-tdt_ctc-0.6b-ja i8 DRQ + minimal probe bisect_resadd1_i8

rewrite_hints.rewrite: run the i8 file on CPU or ship f32 weights for GPU (both verified)
rewrite_hints.symptom: GPU compile fails instantly on any DRQ transformer block (residual FC)

rewrite_hints.expected_effect: device compile passes without the op

entries.conditions: On-device compile rejects MEAN when every input is a constant: `MEAN: Expected 1 const input tensor(s), but node has 2 const input(s)`; the desktop blocklist check passes.

rewrite_hints.rewrite: taint the constant to runtime with + 1e-9 * x.mean() (non-folding; numerically negligible)
rewrite_hints.symptom: LayerNorm applied to a constant parameter blocks device compile

entries.conditions: Dynamic output size rejected by the device delegate (nn.Upsample(scale_factor=2) lowering).
On-device compile rejects SELECT when all inputs are constants (same constant-only-input class as MEAN/DIV; desktop check passes).

A single multi-axis reduction over a large spatial extent (~65k elements) compiles and runs but silently returns NaN — in FP32 as well, so not an fp16 overflow. Two sequential single-axis reductions and AVERAGE_POOL_2D are numerically identical and compute correctly; adaptive_avg_pool2d (which lowers to the same single multi-axis SUM) does not.

rewrite_hints.rewrite: split x.mean((2,3)) into x.mean(3).mean(2) or use AVERAGE_POOL_2D
rewrite_hints.symptom: global average pool returns NaN on device while desktop output is fine
